message: Runs code every time Python starts. Nothing in this project needs that.
Code built at run time from an encoded string.
A download piped into a shell.
Text inside a file named like a binary asset. Scripts get hidden under font and image names this way.
Editor settings. Remove them and keep editor files in your global gitignore.
Invisible or direction-changing characters in the text.
A line that starts with a long run of whitespace, which pushes its content off the screen.
Names written as unicode escapes, which is how obfuscated scripts hide what they call.
